BRICS Summit Spurs Delhi Hotel Demand, Rates Surge

The upcoming BRICS Summit in Delhi has significantly increased demand for hotel accommodations in the Delhi-NCR region. Luxury hotel room rates have reportedly crossed ₹80,000 per night, with some reports indicating prices reaching up to ₹2.5 lakh per night. This surge in demand is attributed to the summit, driving up occupancy and pricing for hospitality services in the area.
